label: Emergency
internal_note: Hardcoded; listed for completeness. Do not test-call.

label: Shelter tonight (Detroit, Hamtramck, Highland Park)
internal_note: The City publishes this number for shelter intake. camdetroit.org and some partners still publish 313-305-0311; we follow the City (DECISIONS 2026-09-18).

label: Shelter help (Dearborn)
internal_note: Out-Wayne County Continuum of Care housing crisis line (Wayne Metro): Wayne County outside Detroit, Hamtramck and Highland Park. Read on their page in a browser 2026-09-19; the site answers scripts with 403, so check:emergency logs it as unreadable. Walk-in: 2005 Biddle Ave, Wyandotte; 11131 Wayne Rd, Romulus.

label: Mental health and addiction help, 24 hours (DWIHN)
internal_note: DWIHN's ACCESS line: 24/7 crisis line and the front door for publicly funded drug and alcohol treatment in all of Wayne County (research 2026-09-19, docs/research/2026-09-19-new-help/treatment-2-system-and-data.md). Some provider pages print wrong DWIHN numbers (800-421-4949, 800-231-1127, 800-841-4949); use only DWIHN's own pages.

label: National drug and alcohol helpline (SAMHSA)
internal_note: Free, 24/7, English and Spanish. TTY 1-800-487-4889. Text a ZIP code to 435748 (English only). Read on the owner page 2026-09-19.

label: Sexual assault help, 24 hours (Avalon Healing Center)
internal_note: Printed as 313-474-SAFE. Formerly Wayne County SAFE; free exams and advocates for all ages. Asks survivors to call first and does not publish its exam sites. Its /contact/ page has a tap-to-call link that dials 313-475-7233 (a bug on their page; tell Avalon, never copy that link).

label: Michigan sexual assault hotline (VOICES4), call or text
internal_note: Statewide, 24/7, anonymous. TTY 517-381-8470. The MDHHS Wayne County directory lists a different text number (866-238-1454); both owner pages (michigan.gov/voices4, mcedsv.org/hotline) say text 855-864-2374.

label: Walk in any time: DWIHN Care Center, 707 W. Milwaukee, Detroit
internal_note: 24/7 walk-in crisis unit for mental health or substance use; no ID, insurance or appointment needed (DWIHN). A crisis unit, not a detox. Also listed as sal_dwihn_care_center (health.mental).
